text: Flux balance analysis (FBA) predicts absolute intracellular fluxes with the same resolution as ¹³C metabolic flux analysis, making ¹³C-MFA unnecessary for resolving parallel pathways.
explanation: This is false: FBA only predicts an optimal flux distribution under an assumed objective and cannot distinguish between parallel pathways carrying equivalent net stoichiometry, such as glycolysis versus the pentose phosphate pathway. ¹³C-MFA is specifically needed to provide absolute, quantitative flux measurements in exactly these cases where FBA's optimization-based predictions are insufficient.
